title: Manga 'Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Enma Akiyama 's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi ( Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ) manga on Monday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Jurassic Park Films Actor Sam Neill Dies at 78
content: The official Instagram account of actor Sam Neill announced that the actor died on Monday in Sydney, Australia. He was 78. The announcement stated that Neill's death was sudden and unexpected, but that he had remained cancer free. The announcement added that more details will be shared at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Enma Akiyama's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi. Gets TV Anime
content: Kadokawa announced on Monday the television anime adaptation of Enma Akiyama 's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi . ( Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend. ) manga, and revealed the anime's teaser visual and main staff members.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams Psyren, The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime
content: Crunchyroll will stream Psyren worldwide excluding Japan and China. The anime will premiere in October. REMOW describes the anime: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Gets TV Anime in Winter 2027
content: An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of NANAI Umihoshi's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga on Monday, revealing the main staff and a two teaser visual (pictured above). The anime series is scheduled to premiere in January 2027 at 2:00 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Amekiri's 'Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun' BL Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: Shinshokan 's Dear Plus label announced on Saturday Amekiri 's Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun (Wait a second, Harutora-kun) boys-love manga will get a live-action series on August 13. The series will air on MBS and other channels.
author: ANN

title: Colopl Announces Shironeko Project Infinity Game for 2027 Release on Switch, Switch 2
content: Colopl revealed on Saturday its Shironeko Project Infinity game will launch for the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 in 2027. The game will feature characters from the Shironeko Project New World's game.
author: ANN

title: Umihoshi Nanai's Kizuguchi to Hōtai Manga Gets TV Anime in January 2027
content: J.C. Staff announced on Monday that it is producing a television anime adaptation of Umihoshi Nanai 's Kizuguchi to Hōtai (Wound and Bandage) manga that will debut in January 2027. The staff revealed two visuals, with the second visual being a "weak loving" version.
author: ANN

title: Kōji Miura's Blue Box Manga Ends
content: This year's 33rd issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine published the final chapter of Kōji Miura 's Blue Box manga on Monday. The 27th volume will ship on October 2 and the 28th and final volume will ship on December 4.
author: ANN

title: 4 Sci-Fi Anime From 1998 That All Millennials Know Are Undeniable Classics
content: The ’80s and ’90s were great decades for sci-fi anime, and one year in particular brought Millennials multiple classics in the category.
